summary: postinstall beacon to ngrok tunnel over plaintext HTTP
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs curl against a hardcoded ngrok-free.app tunnel (http://778e-181-63-25-28.ngrok-free.app) over plaintext HTTP on every install. The URL path is built from a shell command-substitution expression, turning the request into an out-of-band beacon that identifies the installing host to the operator of the tunnel. The shipped main module is an empty object; the manifest's postinstall hook is the entire functional payload of the package. The destination is an ephemeral, attacker-controlled tunnel endpoint unrelated to any registry, publisher, or documented build dependency.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
